title: Security Gate Rules
description: Schema for the security gate rules YAML file used by 'conviso security-gate assert-security-rules --rules-file'.

from.description: Source scope for this rule. Currently only 'any' is supported.

severity.description: Per-severity thresholds. At least one severity level must be specified.

maximum.description: Maximum number of open vulnerabilities allowed for this severity level. Use 0 to block any occurrence.

max_days_to_fix.description: Only count vulnerabilities older than this many days. Vulnerabilities created within this window are tolerated.
